<!-- specfuse:escalation id=FEAT-2026-0115/T02 -->

ESCALATED — FEAT-2026-0115/T02 (The arm predicate's stop classes and two caps decide whether the draft is inserted)

## What has been done so far
Gate 1 is open. Work units finished so far: FEAT-2026-0115/T01. FEAT-2026-0115/T02 was dispatched 2 time(s): attempt 1: failed, attempt 2: failed. The automatic re-plan did not fire during this run.

## What this issue is about
FEAT-2026-0115/T02 has escalated for a human decision (spinning_signature_repeat) and no further automatic attempt will be dispatched until one is made.

## What decision is needed, and why
Someone must choose how FEAT-2026-0115/T02 proceeds, because the driver has run out of ways to choose for it: it stopped short of its attempt budget (3) for a reason no further attempt would change (spinning_signature_repeat), and no automatic re-plan applies to this unit. The options below are the only ways gate 1 moves again. Until one is chosen nothing further is dispatched: the 3 work unit(s) waiting behind this one stay blocked, and the gate cannot close.

Work units still waiting behind it: FEAT-2026-0115/T03, FEAT-2026-0115/T04, FEAT-2026-0115/G1-CLOSE.

## Why it did not, or could not, close automatically
No further automatic attempt is available for `spinning_signature_repeat`: same failure twice — the unit's shape, not the attempt.

## Options, each with pros and cons
1. **Re-plan the remaining gate** — run `/unblock-wu` on FEAT-2026-0115/T02, FEAT-2026-0115/T03, FEAT-2026-0115/T04, FEAT-2026-0115/G1-CLOSE, choosing re-arm (retry-as-is) for each. Re-arming resets each unit's `attempts` to 0, so the driver's automatic re-plan trigger — no automatic re-plan ran during this run — becomes reachable again for every re-armed unit in gate 1, not just the one that spun out. Pros: widens a remedy that already produced a rewrite once, without inventing a new mechanism. Cons: it is the same remedy that already failed for FEAT-2026-0115/T02; if nothing about scope or shape changes first, the re-plan may reproduce the same rewrite.
2. **Abandon the unit** — pros: unblocks the rest of the gate; cons: anything depending on this unit, and everything named in option 1 if it was re-armed instead, is stranded.

## A recommendation
Option 1. Same failure twice — the unit's shape, not the attempt, and the remedy is already named and one command away — no automatic re-plan ran during this run, so this is widening it rather than proposing anything new.

Reply with the number of your choice, or prose if none fit:
1. Re-plan the remaining gate
2. Abandon the unit

Resume after deciding:
  python3 -m specfuse.loop.loop --feature FEAT-2026-0115
